about: The warm-ups the public warm-up player offers at /warmups/<id> (docs/seo-growth-plan.md item 8), reviewed by the courses lead. Each points at a course step for its notes (from: course id, lesson id, step index; never a copy), with `pattern` (its notes in semitones from the first, repeats kept) so the course check fails if that step changes. `bounds` keep every note, as climbed, between `low` and `high` semitones from the singer's comfortable note (or inside a saved range, whichever is narrower). `tempo` and `climb` (semitones up from the start, then back down) give the player's choices and defaults. Words are { en }.

instruction.en: Close your lips loosely and blow so they flutter, "brr", then let your voice ride the trill up five notes and back down. Can't trill? Hum instead.

stop.en: Breathe normally between rounds. Stop if you feel light-headed or if anything tightens.

instruction.en: Hum on "mm" with your lips lightly closed and your teeth apart: three notes up and back, feeling a buzz on your lips.

stop.en: Keep it soft and easy. Stop if anything tightens or scratches.

instruction.en: Sing "oo" softly, three notes up and back down, landing each note before you move on.

stop.en: A medium volume, the middle of your voice. Stop if anything tightens.

instruction.en: Sing do, mi, so and back down: the notes of a major chord, one at a time. Aim for each note cleanly, without sliding up into it.

stop.en: Light on the top note. Stop if anything tightens or scratches.
